description: NaVF₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to seven F¹⁻ atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent VF₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one VF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-40°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.45 Å. V⁵⁺ is bonded to six F¹⁻ atoms to form VF₆ octahedra that share corners with five equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of V-F bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.82 Å. There are four inequivalent F¹⁻ sites. In the first F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and one V⁵⁺ atom. In the second F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one V⁵⁺ atom. In the third F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na¹⁺ and one V⁵⁺ atom. In the fourth F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na¹⁺ and one V⁵⁺ atom.
